hook.name: KeyarchHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that anchors pool prices to Chainlink oracle prices by dynamically adjusting LP fees based on drift. Swaps that close the price gap pay lower fees (down to minFee); swaps that widen it pay higher fees (up to maxFee) or revert if drift exceeds a circuit-breaker threshold. A configurable protocol fee is taken from each swap's output via afterSwap delta.
